استحببن (form X)
# اِسْتَحْبَبْنَ (istaḥbabna) /is.taħ.bab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَحَبَّ (istaḥabba)
# اُسْتُحْبِبْنَ (ustuḥbibna) /us.tuħ.bib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَحَبَّ (istaḥabba)
# اِسْتَحْبِبْنَ (istaḥbibna) /is.taħ.bib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَحَبَّ (istaḥabba)
